name: BDC_CLAIM_STATUS
description: This table contains information about the claim status for claim status follow-up (BDC) records, including claim status reason codes and claim status codes.

columns.name: BDC_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the den/corr rec record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: CLAIM_STAT_RSN_C_NAME
columns.description: Status reason code of the claim status message linked to the claim status follow-up record.

columns.name: CLM_STATUS_CODE_C_NAME
columns.description: Status code loaded from a ANSI 277 message from the payer that indicates the status of the claim.

columns.name: CLM_STATUS_DATA
columns.description: Status code string for when the status code is unmapped.
